name_en: Free electricity for agricultural service connections
department: Energy Department, Government of Tamil Nadu (TANGEDCO / TNPDCL)
benefit: Farm pump set connections in Tamil Nadu get electricity free. The Tamil Nadu Government pays the power company for it. Under KAVIADP Scheme-II, SC/ST farmers get new farm connections with free electricity charges.

evidence.quote: subsidy to all agricultural free service connections as fixed by the Hon'ble Tamil Nadu Electricity Regulatory Commission
individual SC/ST Farmers with free electricity charges
subsidy to all agricultural free service connections

gaps: The policy note does not say how to apply for a new farm connection or what papers you need.
The source is the 2024-25 Energy policy note; the 2025-26 note does not repeat the word 'free'.

review.note: Only a 2024-25 policy note confirms free farm power, and it gives no steps to apply.

verification.method: Automatic: every quote matched in the saved official source (tools/check.py).
